name: Luciole
description:
A Spotlight-style launcher: one shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Space) to find applications, files, folders, Settings panels and answers to calculations.

Local and private: no network access. Luciole writes to the clipboard only when you ask it to: Enter on a calculation copies the answer, Ctrl+C copies the chosen file or folder for Files to paste, and the menu of actions can copy a file's path or name.
